title: Concrete tensor pullback is an additive left adjoint
statement: For a morphism $g:X\to Y$ of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], there is an additive functor $P:\operatorname{Mod}(O_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with objects $O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}O_Y}g^{-1}M$ and morphisms $1\otimes g^{-1}a$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], left adjoint to $g_*$ [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Compose the tensor/restriction Hom equivalence with the inverse-image/direct-image Hom equivalence. The ring adjunction triangle identifies the composite scalar map with g-sharp. The sectionwise unit formula proves naturality for the prescribed tensor maps. Construct the functor and adjunction from these equivalences. As a left adjoint between abelian categories it preserves zero and binary coproducts, hence is additive.

theorem exists_tensorModulePullback
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
      (h : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y),
        P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
          (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M))
      (_ : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)} (a : M ⟶ N),
        P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
          (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap g.hom.base Y.sheaf M a) ≫
          eqToHom (h N).symm)
      (_ : P.Additive),
      Nonempty (P ⊣ moduleDirectImage g)
